recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No current core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-9645 unless a new work-group decision separately revisits generic terminology around conformance resources.
issue_request: FHIR-9645 was a Published FHIR-core/FHIR-I change request with resolution Persuasive with Modification. It reported confusion between the Conformance resource and the generic phrase conformance resources, and the accepted resolution was to rename the Conformance resource to CapabilityStatement unless there was significant pushback.
initial_application: FHIR-9645 was applied by commit 6106a1be5b1703ee84bdbe31a1b6202faa8a567c, whose subject is '#9645 - rename Conformance to CapabilityStatement' and whose git-svn-id corresponds to the Jira comment citing SVN revision #9961. That commit changed source/fhir.ini from conformance=Conformance to capabilitystatement=CapabilityStatement and renamed source/conformance resource inputs to source/capabilitystatement inputs.
additional_context: FHIR-11459 is a later Published duplicate that asks for the same rename and points back to FHIR-9645. The current build-scope source registers CapabilityStatement as the active resource, the current StructureDefinition identity is CapabilityStatement, and source searches found no active current Conformance resource definition. Direct Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the approved rename is already present in current source.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-11459 is a later Published duplicate of this issue that asked for the same Conformance-to-CapabilityStatement rename.
